lastCompletedStory.title: Bake claude onboarding + /workspace trust config into the cam-worker image

openQuestions: Operator ceremony (live prompt-suppression check via interactive docker exec -it ... claude --agent) is not part of this PRD; hand-file via /cam-issue when a real image rebuild + Docker is available.
CAM-176 (firewall wiring) and the full CAM-175 end-to-end re-run are separate follow-ups.
If a future CAM-177 lands a .dockerignore, it MUST NOT exclude .devcontainer/claude-config.json.
nextStoryContext: US-001 baked claude-config.json (5 keys: hasCompletedOnboarding, theme, bypassPermissionsModeAccepted, projects[/workspace].hasTrustDialogAccepted, hasCompletedProjectOnboarding) into the Dockerfile via a COPY before ARG HOST_UID so the existing chown -R re-owns it. No run-argv changes to worker-container.ts or ensure-container.ts. The claude-code-config volume mount at /home/bun/.claude (directory) is untouched; .claude.json (file at /home/bun/.claude.json) is separate. The test uses \nARG HOST_UID as the search pattern to avoid matching occurrences of the string inside Dockerfile comments.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Docs confirm ~/.claude.json stores per-project trust state and per-project settings; the five baked keys are internal state fields consistent with this documented purpose. Specific key names are not in public docs (empirically validated via CAM-175 against host ~/.claude.json).
